description:
A newborn's cry echoes through a frozen cave. As a deadly white serpent rises to strike, a mighty giant bursts through the rocks and saves the helpless child.

He raises her as his own daughter, protecting her from the dangers of the snowy wilderness. As the years pass, she grows stronger, learning to survive and hunt alongside the giant she calls family.

But one bitter argument changes everything. When she leaves their home, her journey leads her into the hands of a ruthless lord who sees the giant as a fortune waiting to be captured.

Now, with his daughter imprisoned in the city square and a deadly crossbow aimed at his chest, the giant must face an army to save the only person he has ever called his own.

A powerful fantasy adventure about love, family, loyalty, and a father's unstoppable determination to protect his daughter.
